name: Point Cloud Optimization via Pointersect
definition: An optimization process that adjusts the position $p$ and color $c$ of a noisy point cloud $P$ to minimize the difference between rendered images (using pointersect) and input ground-truth RGB images and foreground masks.
summary: Pointersect Inverse Rendering Optimization jointly refines noisy point cloud geometry and appearance by minimizing photometric differences using Pointersect's differentiable cloud-ray intersection for dense surface regularization.
